task: per-entity sentiment on SEntFiN 1.0 multi-entity headlines

finbert_headline_baseline.note: one shared headline label applied to every entity - the approach the per-entity layer replaces

interpretation: SEntFiN 1.0 benchmark (400 multi-entity headlines, 907 human-labeled entity judgments, fixed seed-42 sample): the per-entity extraction layer (Qwen3-4B-Instruct, JSON output) scores 72.4% accuracy / 0.748 macro F1, vs 59.8% / 0.597 for the headline-level shared score it replaces (+12.7pp). Human annotator agreement on this task is ~69% (Sinha et al. 2022), so the layer operates at the practical ceiling. This is why one score per headline is not enough: multi-entity headlines carry opposite signals for different companies.
